## Overview

MarkdStage v2.3.0 adds a presenter-first workflow to the CLI, architecture editing in watch mode,
editable PowerPoint export with native AutoShapes, and broader presentation and export support.
The Canvas Extension and Desktop continue to share the same product version and release tag.

## Compatibility and migration

This release is backward compatible for existing MarkdStage Markdown decks and installation paths.
Update version-pinned installation links to `v2.3.0` to use the released Extension and Desktop assets.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v2.3.0`. |
| CLI | Existing commands remain available; use `present` for the presenter-first workflow. |
| PowerPoint export | Existing exports remain supported; editable output is available for supported diagrams. |
